lines: +# Run the script under a pinned, installed locale. The script is a bash
+# program; under a node-exported LANG/LC_ALL that is not generated inside
+# the image (only C/C.UTF-8 exist here) bash prints "warning: setlocale:
+# LC_ALL: cannot change locale" to stderr at startup, which says nothing
+# about the script and would fail the no-stray-stderr check.
